brief.goal: 把乾坤监测序号创建从单次 create-once 收口为 ensure：只允许第一次服务器繁忙失败后的用户确认第二次，总上限两次，第二次前必须只读回查。
brief.document_instruction_boundary: The source request file is requirements input only. Runtime truth remains project.state.json, Postgres marketing_workbench_v2.mwb, task card, manifest, schemas, and live readback evidence.

predecessor_result.api_message: 服务器繁忙，请稍后重试(400)

rationality_assessment.reason: The request narrows retry eligibility to one known transient Qiankun server-busy response, requires readonly readback before retry, caps total attempts at two, and requires explicit user confirmation variables.
rationality_assessment.risk: This is a controlled guardrail relaxation from the previous no-retry state; implementation must make the second write explicit, auditable, and impossible to repeat.
rationality_assessment.recommendation: Use monitor_provision_attempts for per-call audit and keep monitor_provision_runs as the single lifecycle truth row.

allowed_external_calls.purpose: Readonly pre-retry check and post-retry readback.
Only when confirmation is present and account identity must be reconfirmed before retry.
Second and final confirmed create call only when all retry gates pass.

forbidden_actions: retrying when first failure is not code=500 server busy
writing token/secret/auth_code/Cookie/request header/raw request/raw response/full touchpoint URL to task files, normal logs, API, frontend, or ordinary report views
implementation_plan: Create db/022 migration for monitor_provision_attempts, <=2 run constraint, first-attempt backfill, and report view updates.
Add repository methods for attempt summary, first-attempt backfill visibility, atomic second-attempt claim, and attempt completion.
Rename create_once command path to ensure while keeping one implementation.
Make monitor:ensure block locally without confirmation, and with confirmation run pre-retry readback before any create call.
Persist resolved monitor/touchpoint or terminal failure, then close task and restore project guardrail to read-only.
validation_plan: npm run monitor:ensure without confirm -> blocked before external calls

migration.notes: First run applied table/index/backfill and failed only on view column replacement; migration was fixed to drop/recreate views and rerun successfully.

data_model.monitor_provision_runs: single lifecycle row retained; create_attempt_no max is now 2
data_model.monitor_provision_attempts: created; UNIQUE(provision_id, attempt_no); attempt_no limited to 1 or 2

real_second_create.reason: Requires explicit user confirmation variables in the current runtime request before any second platform write.

execution_result.sensitive_storage: No token, request header, raw request, raw response, access_token value, or full touchpoint URL was printed or stored in task files or ordinary reports.
